thread:
Asha: quick heads-up — I pushed a draft of the validator snippets for the function-calling migration: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478
Marta: thanks! linking it in the migration guide sounds good, will skim now :eyes:
Ken: I tried the Node SDK example, small nit — the example uses `response.body` but our SDK returns `data` now. broke the snippet tests in CI.
Asha: ah, good catch. i copied from the old guide. will update to `data` and rerun.
Tom: also the JSON schema example in the doc doesn't include the `additionalProperties: false` guard; customers keep hitting loose parses without it. recommend adding a short note on tradeoffs.
Marta: agree — mention that strict schemas can break heuristics that rely on extra fields, so add a "compatibility" callout.
Asha: drafting change: will add `"additionalProperties": false` to the canonical schema and a 1-line compatibility callout.
Ken: for the SDK snippet, can you use this pattern instead?
Ken: ```js
const res = await client.call({
  model: 'redwood-4',
  input: prompt,
});
const payload = res.data; // already parsed
// validate payload against AJV and schema
```
Asha: perfect. i'll swap that. thanks.
Marta: CI failure details: snippets-test -> parsing-snippets.js line 42. The failing assertion expects properties to be present even when optional. Might need to show both strict and permissive examples.
Asha: good point — i'll add a permissive example showing `additionalProperties: true` and explain when to use it.
Tom: also please fix two broken doc links I found: the tool-calling section links to `tool-specs.md` but the file moved. add a redirect link or fix path. :link:
Asha: noted — i'll update links and add a quick changelog item in the PR description.
docs-bot: PR #478 triggered preview build: https://deployments.redwood-inference.com/previews/478 (status: failed)
Marta: preview failed because of the snippet linter. once we adjust the SDK example it should clear.
Ken: recommend adding a tiny unit test for the AJV schema we show; put it under docs/tests/schema-validators.test.js so it runs in snippets-test.
Asha: adding test. anyone want to review before i request an approver?
Tom: i'll do a pass on wording and the compatibility callout.
Marta: i'll check the code snippets and CI after your push.
Asha: pushed fixes: updated SDK snippet to `data`, added strict/permissive schema examples, fixed links, added unit test. requesting review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478
docs-bot: preview build: https://deployments.redwood-inference.com/previews/478 (status: success)
Ken: looked good, test coverage OK. :shipit:
Tom: wording tweaks done. left one inline nit about phrasing in the compatibility paragraph.
Marta: approving now.
Asha: thanks all — merging in 5. will follow up in the migration checklist to call out the schema compatibility note. :tada:
Tom: great. can we backport a short note to the Dedicated docs? some customers on reserved capacity need the compatibility guidance.
Asha: yep, I'll open a follow-up PR against the enterprise branch after this merges.
Marta: thanks for running point on this, Asha :clap:
Asha: no prob!
